relations.zotero_refs:
[CTAI38G9]: 929 and [FEHIEFEB]: 144. "bla ma 'jam dpal"/'Jam dbyangs skya bo" follows "Zhang btsun mDo sde dpal" in the lineage of the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772).
[Z5FZQCNC]: 141-142. Lineage of the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772) according to the Fifth Dalai Lama: from Śākyaśrībhadra (ID:6418), Sugataśrī (ID:6616), Dānaśīla (ID:6032), and Saṅghaśrī (ID:6617), to Sa paN (ID:3892). Then to 'U yug pa Rig[s] pa'i seng ge (ID:3846), Zhang mDo sde dpal (ID:6624), 'Jam skya Nam mkha' dpal (ID:6621), dPang lo tsA ba Blo gros brtan pa (ID:4097), etc. 
[Z5FZQCNC]: 142. Lineage of the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772) according to Ngag dbang chos grags (ID:6897): from Kha che paN chen (ID:6418) to Sa paN (ID:3892). Then from Sa paN it goes directly to Lho pa kun mkhyen (ID:5463), 'U yug pa (ID:3846), and Zhang mDo sde dpal (ID:6624). Then from the latter to 'Jam dbyangs skya bo (ID:6621), then to dPang lo tsA ba (ID:4097), etc. 
[Z5FZQCNC]: 144. Lineage of the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772) according to 'Gos lo tsA ba (ID:5839): Kha che PaN chen Śākyaśrī (ID:6418), Sa paN (ID:3892), 'U yug pa (ID:3846), Zhang btsun mDo sde dpal (ID:6624), 'Jam dbyangs skya bo (ID:6621), dPal ldan pa, 'Jam dbyangs sTon gzhon (ID:5942), Nor bzangs dpal (ID:6604), etc.
